issues.description: Several practical recommendations (anonymizace/pseudonymizace, redakce jmen, doporučený postup pro retenční lhůty) are supported by the handbook content but lack explicit in-text citations to the most relevant sections (2.2.2 / 9.3.3 / 9.4.1).
issues.required_fix: Add explicit footnotes or cross-references to the handbook excerpts that document anonymization/pseudonymization best practices (section 2.2.2), the DPIA template (section 9.3.3), and the RAG blueprint/checklist (section 9.4.1) for each corresponding bullet.

issues.description: The DPIA / DPA bullet is annotated inline with '(general background knowledge)'. This inline tag is awkward in the checklist and may confuse readers about whether an action is required.
issues.required_fix: Replace the inline label with a short footnote pointing to the handbook templates (e.g., section 9.3.3) and/or to the institutional/legal guidance. Keep the checklist item actionable (e.g., 'Proveďte DPIA, pokud zpracováváte osobní údaje; viz vzor DPIA v sekci 9.3.3').

issues.description: Retention policy entry uses a placeholder 'doba uchování X měsíců' without guidance on how to choose a value or where to record it.
issues.required_fix: Replace the placeholder with an instruction to align retention periods with institutional policy or legal requirements and add a reference to the handbook sections that discuss retention/DPA/DPIA (e.g., 2.2/9.3/9.4). Example wording: 'nastavte retenční politiku v souladu s institucionálními pravidly (uved'te dobu a odůvodnění v dokumentaci projektu / viz sekce 9.3.3)'. (Do not invent numeric retention periods.)

issues.description: Footnotes inside list items use human-readable labels like 'Source: sekce 9.3.1 (...)' while other footnotes point to kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_3_1. Mixing free-text references and KB cite_keys may reduce consistency.
issues.required_fix: Standardize footnotes to either institution section references (e.g., 'viz sekce 9.3.1') or to KB cite_keys consistently. Ensure the LaTeX footnote text is short and consistent with the handbook citation style used elsewhere in the document.

issues.description: The checklist is practical but could be slightly more actionable for course guarantors: e.g., indicate who (role) should confirm each item and suggest a place to store evidence (LMS, project folder).
issues.required_fix: Add a short parenthetical or column indicating the responsible role for each 'Zařazení do zprovoznění' check item (např. 'Garantuje: garant předmětu / IT / právní oddělení') and a suggested evidence location (LMS/drive/path), or add this as a short companion note.

suggested_edits.target: Mapování dat (co se bude indexovat) bullet
suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Add footnote referencing section 9.4.1 (Základní RAG blueprint / Architektura RAG) and to the earlier 'Architektura RAG pro kurzy' text that lists typical sources (LMS, prezentace, sylaby, FAQ) to ground the list of example sources. Example footnote: 'Viz sekce 9.4.1 (Architektura RAG) a doporučení o indexovaných zdrojích.'

Add a footnote to section 2.2.2 (Anonymizace a pseudonymizace) and to 9.3.3 (vzorné DPIA) to support recommendations to pseudonymize and redact names. Replace any prescriptive numeric examples with a reference to institutional guidance (do not invent retention periods).

Remove inline '(general background knowledge)' label. Instead, add a short actionable sentence and a footnote: 'Proveďte DPIA tam, kde RAG zpracovává osobní údaje; viz vzor DPIA v sekci 9.3.3.' Mark the item as required when personal data are processed.

Replace 'doba uchování X měsíců' with: 'nastavte retenční lhůty v souladu s institucionální politikou (uved'te hodnotu a odůvodnění v dokumentu)'; add a footnote pointing to sections 2.2 (retence) and 9.3.3 (DPIA template) for evidence and templates.

suggested_edits.target: Zařazení do zprovoznění kurzu — checklist pro garanty
suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Add a short responsibility column or parenthetical after each checklist item suggesting who should sign off (např. 'hotovo / chybí — kontrola: garant předmětu / IT / právní odd.'), and add a footnote linking to the 'Šablona: Krátký formulář pro studentskou deklaraci AI (LMS)' in memory (section 9.3.1) for the declaration item.
